# NumPy / SciPy to Tessero

Every NumPy or SciPy function Tessero implements through the kernel registry, and the Tessero call for it.
Both backends expose the same classes; the native extension mirrors them under `Tessero\Ext\...`.
Array creation and manipulation (the `NDArray` methods) and the FFT are not registry functions and are
covered by the [arrays](../guide/arrays.md) and [FFT](../guide/fft.md) guides. See the API reference for exact signatures.
